facts: Parties: Northgate Bioscience plc (Buyer), Northgate Holdings Ltd (Seller); the Company is Yarrow Industries Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 28 June 2026; Closing is scheduled for 6 September 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.3 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 20% of the Purchase Price, being $30,000,000. The Purchase Price is $120,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,200,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Larkspur Energy plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.
